name: Veronika Cifrová Ostrihoňová - Après le considérant E - Am 2
title: REPORT on public access to documents – report covering the years 2022 - 2024
part_text: Ea. Whereas in its special report 11/2025, the ECA found that while non-governmental organisations (NGOs) have a strong influence on the EU’s decision-making processes, there is a lack of transparency regarding the EU funding granted to these entities; whereas the report found that important aspects of an NGO’s status were systematically not checked, leading to entities having an incorrect NGO classification in the Financial Transparency System;
